title: HOMESTEAD: Retro-Web Redesign Engine
tagline: Analyze any modern website and rebuild it the way GeoCities, FrontPage, or MySpace would have.
naming_note: GeoCities members were called Homesteaders. The framework borrows the word for the act of moving a modern site into an old neighborhood.

parameters.gif_min_frame_delay_basis: House budget. Two-frame full-contrast alternation reaches the WCAG 2.3.1 three-flashes-per-second line at roughly 167 ms per frame; HOMESTEAD doubles that margin. Tier: INFERENCE from claim C-021.
parameters.gif_tiny_delay_basis: Frames declared at 0 or 1 centisecond are treated as 100 ms, matching common browser clamping. Tier: INFERENCE, verify per browser.
parameters.large_animation_area_basis: WCAG 2.3.1 understanding text uses a 341 x 256 rectangle at 1024 x 768 as the 10 degree visual field estimate. Tier: STATED, claim C-021.
parameters.marquee_note: Marquee still renders in current browsers but needs a pause mechanism under WCAG 2.2.2. The Safe Mode toggle is that mechanism.

asset_policies.originals-only: Every image, sound, and font reference is generated by HOMESTEAD tooling or commissioned new. Default for client work.
asset_policies.archive-allowed: Generic archived glyphs (bullets, rules, construction signs) may be used for portfolio or commentary work, each logged with its source URL. Never recognizable third-party characters.
